01Know your hair

Five questions. A plan made for you.

Hair type, scalp, porosity, water and what worries you most — answered once, on your phone. Your weekly routine builds itself.

02Scan & learn

Know what you put on your hair.

Point the camera at any shampoo, conditioner or oil. StrandWise flags what to avoid, what to watch and what your hair will love — plus traditional remedies with safe usage.

Try the scanner

Paste a label. See what your hair thinks.

The same analysis that runs inside StrandWise — on your device, nothing sent anywhere. Tell it about your hair, then paste any ingredient list.
